text:
alex: Seeing p95 spike in the canary for 2.6.0, deploy-bot flagged it. Can we pause the rollout and evaluate rollback criteria? @sre-oncall please advise.

deploy-bot: [AUTO] Canary rollout: v2.6.0 -> prod. Metric deltas: p95 +22% vs baseline, errors +1.9%. Auto-rollback thresholds: p95 > +25% OR errors > 3%. Current state: PAUSE_RECOMMENDED.
maria: On call for release — thanks. If we're pausing, do we pin the traffic or fully pause the shift? Need list of impact customers for messaging.
kevin: Recommend immediate traffic pause (stop further ramp) and prepare manual rollback to 2.5.3 if health doesn't recover in 5m. Quick rollback command: `deployctl rollback --env=prod --to=2.5.3 --scope=canary`
sre-oncall: Acknowledged. I'll run a 5m health window. My exec criteria for manual rollback: sustained p95 > +18% for 5m AND errors >1.5% OR any user-facing 5xx spike >0.5%. If met, I'll execute.
jules: I'll start drafting a short customer note and update release notes. What language should we use for reason? "performance regression observed in canary" ok? Also who owns the post-rollback verification note?
katie-pm: Include "potential increased latency" and that we're reverting to a stable build; add a line asking impacted customers to DM support for immediate help. I'll compile impacted customers after kevin/fetch.
alex: Quick numbers from the dashboard: canary shard (10%) p95 +22%, mean +8%, errors 1.9% (mostly 502/504). No obvious DB errors in logs yet.
deploy-bot: [AUTO] Safety hold engaged: rollout paused, no further traffic shifts. Auto-rollback did NOT trigger (thresholds not crossed) — manual rollback advised. Recorded canary snapshots: 2512345678.
kevin: Initiating manual rollback now to 2.5.3 for canary slice. Command: `deployctl set-version --env=prod --selector=canary --image=redwood:2.5.3 && deployctl monitor --duration=10m` Rolling back, will report status. :gear:
sre-oncall: Rolling back in progress. Watchers: me, kevin. Running health checks and ksvc readiness. ETA ~4m to complete and verification.
kevin: Rollback applied to canary slice, traffic remains pinned at 10% pending verification. Logs show pods restarting cleanly. :white_check_mark:
deploy-bot: [AUTO] Post-change telemetry: p95 now +1% vs baseline, errors 0.6%. Canary health: OK. Recommended action: continue gradual roll forward only after 30m stable or open canary for broader validation.
maria: Good — I'll finalize the release notes line: "Reverted canary to v2.5.3 due to a performance regression observed in limited rollout; team investigating." Jules, please send customer note once I drop the short justification sentence.
jules: Draft ready, will send to support and the customers list after maria's sign-off. Creating incident ticket and assigning to eng-ml for root cause analysis.
katie-pm: Added a short blurb to the customer-facing update and flagged top 5 accounts for outreach.
alex: Thanks everyone. Action items: eng-ml triage (root cause), postmortem doc, update release schedule (hold v2.6.0 until RCA). Closing this thread once postmortem ticket created. :thumbsup:
